title: Cohere Command A Reasoning Model support
body:
### Description

Cohere released a new Reasoning model Command A Reasoning and the AI SDK doesn't support it yet since they are passing a new thinking object in the responses. 

Example:
https://docs.cohere.com/reference/chat-stream#response.body.content-start
https://docs.cohere.com/reference/chat-stream#response.body.content-delta

### AI SDK Version

- ai: 5.0.22
- @ai-sdk/cohere: 2.0.5

### Code of Conduct

- [x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct

linked_prs.title: feat(provider/cohere): reasoning model support
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Cohere introduced reasoning with their latest model `command-a-reasoning-08-2025`:
https://docs.cohere.com/docs/reasoning

## Summary

Implements handling for reasoning in `CohereChatLanguageModel` for both `generateText()` and `streamText()` as well as provider options to configure the reasoning.

## Manual Verification

1. [examples/ai-core/src/generate-text/cohere-reasoning.ts
](https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/13ac81da66886f8080c9f1bcf6ddfb5bf6f6dcae/examples/ai-core/src/generate-text/cohere-reasoning.ts)
2. [examples/ai-core/src/stream-text/cohere-reasoning.ts
](https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/13ac81da66886f8080c9f1bcf6ddfb5bf6f6dcae/examples/ai-core/src/stream-text/cohere-reasoning.ts)

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns support for a new LLM model ("Cohere Command A Reasoning") and involves SDK compatibility and response handling, which falls under "Unsupported models" and "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy.
